[ASSISTANT_SAID] Prices for ANA: $700-$900 USD; Japan Airlines: $650-$850 USD; Singapore Airlines: $750-$950 USD.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that prices are estimates and can vary depending on specific travel dates, flight schedules, and availability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended checking airlines' websites or flight comparison tools for the most up-to-date prices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested considering off-peak days for potentially cheaper flights.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that flights from New York to Tokyo often depart in the evening and arrive in the morning, which can help minimize jet lag.  
[EVENT] User asked about the typical flight duration from New York to Tokyo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided approximate flight durations: non-stop flights take around 11 hours and 15 minutes to 12 hours and 30 minutes; flights with layovers take around 18 hours to 24 hours.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that actual flight times may vary due to weather conditions, air traffic, and flight route changes.
